title: Delivering BC in the Age of AI - Which Soft Skills Still Matter?
summary: Post about soft skills for Business Central professionals in an AI-driven environment, exploring which skills remain valuable as AI tools change the landscape.
key_points: Some soft skills matter more than others as AI tools become prevalent
AI is leveling the playing field for technical capabilities
Finding the right balance of skills is context-dependent for individuals and teams
Discussion covers which professional competencies remain critical
